description: Defines classes and functions for E2SM-RC control services, including style definitions, control style retrieval, and control service base and derived classes for different styles.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_base
classes.description: Abstract base class for E2SM-RC control services, managing style ID, control style definition, and action executors.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service
classes.description: Class for handling E2SM-RC control styles 1-10, derived from the base control service class.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_style_255
classes.description: Class for handling E2SM-RC control style 255 (Multiple Actions), derived from the base control service class.

methods.name: get_e2sm_rc_control_style_def
methods.description: Retrieves the control service definition for a given style ID.

methods.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_base
methods.description: Constructor for initializing control service with a style ID.

methods.name: control_request_supported
methods.description: Checks if a control request is supported for the given style.

methods.name: create_req_f1_from_req_f2
methods.description: Helper function to create a control request F1 from F2 format.
